title: 10 of 10: Surrey Goes BC Conservative #Shorts
description:
BC election results: all 10 Surrey seats went BC Conservative, and a six-term, Bathinda-born MLA is out.
On 24 October, British Columbia voted for 93 seats. The BC Conservatives won or lead in 64, with 47 needed for a majority. Per preliminary community counts, about 15 Punjabi-origin candidates won, from both the BC Conservatives and the NDP. Surrey has deep family ties to Punjab, so many homes in India are watching.
Do you have family in Surrey? Tell us your city in the comments.
Subscribe for the day's news explained in a minute.
Sources: Surrey Now-Leader (25 Oct 2026), Peace Arch News (24 Oct), Tribune India. Images: Wikimedia Commons, Pixabay. Stock clips are for illustration, not of the actual event.
#Shorts #BCElection #Surrey #Punjabi #CurrentAffairs
script:
FORMAT: 1 vertical YouTube Short, ~54 s, 9:16, English, Indian-viewer slot.
EXPIRY: timely news. Publish by 27 Oct 2026 (suggested) and retire/refresh once final Elections BC counts are out. Update the "won or leading, as of 25 Oct" footnote if figures change.

VOICEOVER (Arjun only, Mr. Cut's trimmed VO; fact-checked by Mr. Focus):
HOOK: "Ten out of ten. Surrey's score in BC's election, and a six-term, Bathinda-born MLA is out."
S1: "On 24 October, BC voted for 93 seats. BC Conservatives won or lead in 64, NDP 27, Greens 2. Majority: 47." (on-screen footnote: *won or leading, as of 25 Oct)
S2: "That ten is Surrey. All ten of its seats went BC Conservative." (Source: Surrey Now-Leader, 25 Oct)
S3: "Preliminary community counts: about 15 Punjabi-origin winners. Twelve Conservative, three NDP, including Raj Chouhan, Niki Sharma, Rohini Arora."
S4: "In Surrey North, Mandeep Dhaliwal held his seat, beating the NDP's Sahib Thind. In Surrey-Fleetwood, six-term NDP MLA Jagrup Brar lost to Garry Purewal."
S5: "Why does this matter in India? Surrey is a major Punjabi diaspora centre, with deep family ties to Punjab."
CLOSE: "One more twist: Garry Thind won a school trustee seat, then Surrey-Guildford a week later, which could mean a trustee by-election. Follow for daily news explained."
Final 3 s on-screen: "Family in Surrey? Which city are you in?"

FACT NOTES: Garry Thind (Surrey-Guildford winner, confirmed by Tribune India and PTC News) and Sahib Thind (NDP, Surrey North) are different people. CHECK ALL NAME SPELLINGS AGAINST ELECTIONS BC BEFORE RENDER. No vote percentages.

CAST: Arjun (sole voice, on camera shots 1, 20, 22); Meera (silent 2 s cutaway, shot 17, no second voice); Lumen (silent B-roll, young Indian woman with phone, reacts at 64 and ~15). No AI faces of real politicians; text cards only; no party logos.
